step.cmd: Check in a third-party document as an offline agreement in X-Author for Contracts. For more information, see Creating Offline Agreements.
Check out the offline agreement document.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Review Import Results. If you do not see Review Import under the Work tab, click the More icon () and from the menu, select Review Import results.

postreq.p: Click Review Import Results to start data extraction. You can see the fields and clauses recognized from the document in X-Author for Contracts.
